project_type: Python FastAPI backend with MongoDB (Beanie ODM), Redis (Upstash), Vertex AI, Sarvam AI, Azure Search
build_system: pip with requirements.in/requirements.txt, Docker for production
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, httpx AsyncClient for integration tests
build_command: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.in && python -c 'from app.main import app; print("OK")'
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest tests to confirm no regressions. 2. Verify imports succeed. 3. Docker build validates full environment.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. No live MongoDB/Redis/AI services available in sandbox, so tests must mock external dependencies.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: Beanie Documents for models, router modules in app/api/v1/, services in app/services/, admin auth via _validate_admin_session from admin.py
key_patterns: 1. Routers use APIRouter with prefix registered in main.py under /api/v1/admin. 2. Admin endpoints call _validate_admin_session(request) and _csrf_check(request) for auth. 3. Models are Beanie Documents with Settings.name for collection. 4. Services are singleton instances (e.g., search_service, vertex_client, sarvam_client). 5. DB access via get_mongo_client() for raw motor or Beanie Document class methods. 6. Config via app.config.settings Pydantic Settings. 7. Tests use httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - main app. api/v1/ - route modules. models/ - Beanie Documents. services/ - AI, search, payment clients. db/ - mongo.py and redis.py. core/ - circuit breaker, logging, telemetry. tests/ - pytest suite.
